title: Laguna de Bay water level drops to 11.84 meters amid El Niño

blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — The water level of Laguna de Bay continued to decline, reaching 11.84 meters on Thursday (Nov. 5) under El Niño conditions, the Laguna Lake Development Authority (LLDA) reported. The lake’s water level dropped from 11.87 meters which was recorded on Wednesday (Nov. 4). Based on its latest monitoring, the agency said the lake’s water level “continues to show a steady downward trend.” READ: Laguna de Bay breaches critical mark – LLDA “This declining trend has been consistently observed amid the prevailing El Niño conditions, characterized by reduced rainfall and increased evaporation across the basin,” the LLDA said.
